title: GPT-5 just leaked and it's terrifying

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you hear? GPT-5 just leaked—and it’s way more powerful than anyone expected.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This isn’t just another AI update; it’s a game-changer for the entire tech industry.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: GPT-5 is the next major version of OpenAI’s language model, capable of near-human reasoning.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It uses a new neural architecture that allows it to process 10 times more data in real time.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Everyone from content creators to cybersecurity experts is now at risk of being outpaced.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The takeaway? This leak could shift the balance of power in AI for years to come.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What do you think? Should we be worried or excited about this leak?
